What’s Next for Anthem Inc (NYSE:ANTM) After Having More Shares Shorted?
May 16, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
The stock of Anthem Inc (NYSE:ANTM) registered an increase of 4.95% in short interest. ANTM’s total short interest was 6.88M shares in May as published by FINRA. Its up 4.95% from 6.55 million shares, reported previously. With 2.01M shares average volume, it will take short sellers 3 days to cover their ANTM’s short positions. The short interest to Anthem Inc’s float is 2.68%.
The stock increased 0.69% or $1.59 $232.46. About 287,035 shares traded. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) has risen 35.30% uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.75% the S&P500.
Anthem, Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates as a health benefits firm in the United States. The company has market cap of $59.32 billion. It operates through three divisions: Commercial and Specialty Business, Government Business, and Other. It has a 14.91 P/E ratio. The firm offers a spectrum of network managed care health benefit plans to large and small employer, individual, Medicaid, and Medicare markets. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) Ratings Coverage
